title: SkyDance Skydiving
specs: Only drop zone in the nation approved for skydiving above 28,000 ft
Must be 250 lbs or under for training
Must hold valid USPA C license or foreign equivalent for HALO jumps
Must hold valid FAA class 3 medical certificate or equivalent for HALO jumps
No facial hair other than a mustache for HALO oxygen mask seal
Good physical and mental condition for AFF training
Group discounts available for tandem jumps: $15 off per person for 5-9, $20 off for 10-14, $25 off for 15+
includes: Training Class, Certificate & Logbook entry, Bumper Sticker with tandem jumps
Specialized HALO equipment including O2, mask, helmet, goggles, altimeter, and balaclava
gap: Age minimum not stated for tandem or training
blurb: Guests can do tandem skydives from various altitudes, experienced skydiving jumps, and HALO jumps. Training programs include Accelerated Free Fall (AFF) courses to become licensed solo skydivers. The dropzone provides gear rental, rigging loft, and a friendly community environment.
extraNote: Block jumps valid for 18 months from date of purchase · Pricing and terms subject to change without notice · HALO course reservation requires non-refundable $500 deposit and full payment ahead of time · HALO course reservation is non-refundable and non-creditable but transferable to another jumper · HALO course scheduled for 4 day block; commitment to availability required
